cards.title: Your round 5 notes
cards.text: Dead-end pockets, 1-cell dark tiles, a shorter Dash shared with darts, afterimages, a flat star.
cards.why: Everything from the last two decks. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.8.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

parts.title: Dead ends
parts.text: Dead ends are back, as pockets: any part behind a single way in holds at most 6 squares. So 1 to 6 square dead ends, never a whole branch.

parts.title: Tiles
parts.text: One cell each, a darker wall, white for a moment when hit. Arms 2 cells thick, small clusters, filled-in barriers. In the map they're the bright blue bits.

parts.title: Dash 5
parts.text: Base dash is 5 cells now (was 6 at first). Duration on the Dash makes it longer.

parts.title: Dart uses the Dash
parts.text: The dart aims, then does the same Dash as you, so it goes 5 cells. Its Dash can carry modules later, same as yours.

parts.title: Afterimages
parts.text: Dashes leave fading copies of the body behind; no squares or lines.

parts.title: Duration module
parts.text: Duration is a module now: on a Weapon it's bolt range, on Spawn its life, on Dash its length, +20% a level. 'You' cards are 'Stat' cards.

parts.title: Shard
parts.text: A flat gold four-point star, one colour, turning slowly.
